learn.rule: Because tells the reason. But shows a surprise. So tells the result.
learn.ruleEs: Because dice la razón. But muestra una sorpresa. So dice el resultado.
learn.model: The ice melted quickly because the sun was shining on it.
learn.notice: Look at the word because. What comes after it? The reason the ice melted.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word because? The ice melted quickly because...

options.text: it was very cold outside.
the sun was shining on it.
we put it in the freezer.

items.why: Because is followed by the reason. Sunshine warms ice and makes it melt. The other endings would keep ice frozen.
items.whyEs: Because va seguido de la razón. El sol calienta el hielo y lo derrite. Las otras opciones mantendrían el hielo congelado.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word so? The puddle sat in the sun all afternoon, so...

options.text: it grew bigger and bigger.
it turned into ice.
it dried up.

items.why: So tells the result. Sunshine makes water evaporate, so the puddle dries up.
items.whyEs: So dice el resultado. El sol hace que el agua se evapore, así que el charco se seca.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word but? The sky was full of clouds, but...

options.text: it rained all day.
the clouds were gray.
no rain fell.

items.why: But shows a surprise. Clouds often bring rain, so no rain is the surprise.
items.whyEs: But muestra una sorpresa. Las nubes suelen traer lluvia, así que que no llueva es la sorpresa.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that fits the frog sentence.
parts: the eggs need to stay wet.
items.model: Frogs lay eggs in water because the eggs need to stay wet.
items.why: The second part is the reason, so because is the right word.
items.whyEs: La segunda parte es la razón, así que because es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that fits the ant sentence.
parts: they can carry food much heavier than themselves.
items.model: Ants are tiny, but they can carry food much heavier than themselves.
items.why: Tiny and strong carriers are a surprise together, so but fits.
items.whyEs: Que sean diminutas y aun así carguen tanto es una sorpresa, así que but es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Check every ending that fits the word but. Snails move very slowly, but...

options.text: they can still cross a whole garden.
they have a shell on their backs.
they can still climb up a tall plant.
they eat leaves and flowers.

items.why: But needs a surprise next to moving slowly. Crossing a garden or climbing a plant is that surprise. The others are just extra facts.
items.whyEs: But necesita una sorpresa junto a moverse despacio. Cruzar un jardín o subir una planta lo es. Las otras son solo datos extra.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence three ways: with because, but, and so.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración de tres maneras: con because, but y so.
write.model: Puddles disappear on hot days because the sun heats the water. Puddles disappear on hot days, but they stay longer in the shade. Puddles disappear on hot days, so we cannot splash in them.

familyTalk.en: At home, finish this together three ways: 'The ice melted ...' with because, but, and so.
familyTalk.es: En casa, terminen juntos de tres maneras: 'The ice melted ...' con because, but y so.

teacherTip.en: Project the model and have pairs say all three versions aloud before writing.
teacherTip.es: Proyecta el modelo y pide que las parejas digan las tres versiones en voz alta antes de escribir.

learn.rule: Because tells the reason. But shows a surprise. So tells the result.
learn.ruleEs: Because dice la razón. But muestra una sorpresa. So dice el resultado.
learn.model: Cars stop at a red light because it keeps everyone safe.
learn.notice: After because, we read the reason for stopping. Can you find it?

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word because? Cars stop at a red light because...

options.text: the road is very long and busy.
the red light tells drivers to wait.
the car has four wheels and a horn.

items.why: Because is followed by the reason. A red light is a signal to stop, so that is why cars wait.
items.whyEs: Because va seguido de la razón. La luz roja es una señal para detenerse, por eso los autos esperan.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word so? It was raining hard, so...

options.text: Maya packed her umbrella.
Maya put on sunglasses.
Maya left her coat at home.

items.why: So tells the result. Hard rain leads to taking an umbrella.
items.whyEs: So dice el resultado. La lluvia fuerte lleva a llevar un paraguas.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word but? The library was crowded, but...

options.text: many people came to read.
the shelves were full.
everyone read quietly.

items.why: A crowded room is usually noisy, so quiet readers are a surprise. That is what but shows.
items.whyEs: Un lugar lleno suele ser ruidoso, así que lectores en silencio es una sorpresa. Eso es lo que muestra but.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word for the recycling sentence.
items.model: Our class recycles paper because it helps save trees.
items.why: Helping save trees is the reason the class recycles, so because fits.
items.whyEs: Ayudar a salvar árboles es la razón por la que la clase recicla, así que because es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word for the late bus sentence.
parts: the students waited inside the school.
items.model: The bus was late, so the students waited inside the school.
items.why: Waiting inside is the result of the late bus, so so is the right word.
items.whyEs: Esperar adentro es el resultado de que el autobús llegó tarde, así que so es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Check every ending that fits the word so. The park was clean and safe, so...

options.text: many families visited it.
the swings were broken.
children played there every day.
it rained last night.

items.why: So needs a result of the park being clean and safe. Families visiting and children playing are results. Broken swings or rain are not.
items.whyEs: So necesita un resultado de que el parque esté limpio y seguro. Que lo visiten familias y jueguen niños son resultados. Los columpios rotos o la lluvia no.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence three ways: with because, but, and so.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración de tres maneras: con because, but y so.
write.text: People work together in a town
write.frame: People work together in a town
write.model: People work together in a town because everyone has different jobs. People work together in a town, but they do not all do the same work. People work together in a town, so everyone gets what they need.

familyTalk.en: On your next walk, name one rule you see, like a stop sign. Say why we follow it with because.
familyTalk.es: En su próximo paseo, nombren una regla que vean, como una señal de alto. Digan por qué la seguimos usando because.

teacherTip.en: Ask students to explain why each wrong ending does not fit before moving on.
teacherTip.es: Pide que expliquen por qué cada opción incorrecta no encaja antes de continuar.

learn.rule: Because tells the reason. But shows a surprise. So tells the result.
learn.ruleEs: Because dice la razón. But muestra una sorpresa. So dice el resultado.
learn.model: The turtle hid in her shell because the thunder was loud.
learn.notice: Which part tells why the turtle hid? It comes after because.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word because? The turtle hid in her shell because...

options.text: the grass was soft and green.
the pond was blue and calm.
the thunder was very loud.

items.why: Loud thunder can scare a turtle, so it is the reason she hid.
items.whyEs: El trueno fuerte puede asustar a una tortuga, por eso es la razón por la que se escondió.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word so? The rabbit was very tired, so...

options.text: he ran another mile up the hill.
he fell asleep under a tree.
he began a new race with the fox.

items.why: So tells the result. A tired rabbit rests, so falling asleep is the result.
items.whyEs: So dice el resultado. Un conejo cansado descansa, así que dormirse es el resultado.

items.prompt: Which ending fits the word but? The fox looked sly, but...

options.text: he was really kind to the little bird.
he walked slowly through the quiet woods.
his fur was orange and fluffy.

items.why: Sly sounds tricky, so being kind is a surprise. That is the job of but.
items.whyEs: Sly suena a astuto y tramposo, así que ser amable es una sorpresa. Ese es el trabajo de but.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word for the scared bird sentence.
parts: The bird was scared of the storm,
she hid in a hollow log.
items.model: The bird was scared of the storm, so she hid in a hollow log.
items.why: Hiding is the result of being scared, so so fits.
items.whyEs: Esconderse es el resultado de tener miedo, así que so es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word for the play sentence.
items.model: The children clapped loudly because the play was wonderful.
items.why: The play being wonderful is the reason they clapped, so because fits.
items.whyEs: Que la obra fuera maravillosa es la razón por la que aplaudieron, así que because es la palabra correcta.

items.prompt: Check every ending that fits the word but. The old owl was wise, but...

options.text: he could not find his glasses.
he lived in a tall oak tree.
he did not know the way home.
he knew many stories.

items.why: A wise owl who loses things or gets lost is a surprise, so but fits. Living in a tree or knowing stories adds no surprise.
items.whyEs: Un búho sabio que pierde cosas o se pierde es una sorpresa, así que but encaja. Vivir en un árbol o saber cuentos no agrega sorpresa.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence three ways: with because, but, and so.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración de tres maneras: con because, but y so.
write.model: The turtle was brave because she crossed the road alone. The turtle was brave, but she still felt a little scared. The turtle was brave, so the other animals followed her.

familyTalk.en: Think of a story you both know. Say why a character did something, using because.
familyTalk.es: Piensen en un cuento que ambos conozcan. Digan por qué un personaje hizo algo usando because.

teacherTip.en: Have students act out the surprise in the but sentences to feel the contrast.
teacherTip.es: Pide que representen la sorpresa de las oraciones con but para sentir el contraste.
